name: Is my filled PDF uploaded anywhere?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Everything runs in your browser using pdf-lib and pdf.js. Neither your original PDF nor the filled version is ever sent to a server. PDFree does not have access to your document.

name: What types of PDF form fields are supported?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDFree supports all standard AcroForm field types: text inputs, checkboxes, radio buttons, dropdown lists, and signature fields. Signature fields open a signing pad where you can draw with your finger or mouse, type your name in a cursive font, or upload an image of your signature.

name: Can I fill a scanned PDF form?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not with this tool — scanned PDFs are images without embedded interactive fields. PDFree detects AcroForm fields only. For scanned forms you would need OCR software to convert the scan into a fillable PDF first.

A drawn signature image is an electronic signature. Its legal weight depends on your jurisdiction and the document type. For everyday forms, consent documents, and internal approvals it is widely accepted. For regulated legal contexts, use a certified e-signature service with an audit trail.

name: Is this a free PDF form filler with no sign up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFree is a completely free PDF form filler with no sign up, no account, and no installation. Open the tool, load your PDF, fill out the fields, and download the completed form — no email address required.

name: Can I fill and sign a PDF form online for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFree supports both filling and signing in one step. Fill in text fields and checkboxes, then tap any signature field to open a drawing pad. Sign with your finger on mobile or your mouse on desktop. The signature is embedded in the downloaded PDF.

name: Does this actually fill in my form's real fields, or do I have to place text manually?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDFree detects your PDF's real AcroForm fields — text boxes, checkboxes, radio buttons, dropdowns, and signature fields — and renders them as an actual fillable form. You are not drawing text boxes by hand or guessing at positioning. If your PDF has no embedded fields, PDFree tells you directly instead of pretending to detect fields that aren't there.

name: What if my PDF has no fillable fields?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDFree detects AcroForm interactive fields. If the PDF is a scanned image or a flat document without embedded form fields, you will see a 'No fillable fields found' message. For flat PDFs you can use the Annotate or Watermark tools to add text overlays.
